title: Post Scarcity
body: Post Scarcity asks what a city becomes when abundance uncouples survival from labour. It takes the premise seriously — a fifteen-hour week, a universal basic income, goods at zero marginal cost — and follows it to its conclusions for center city Philadlephia..
The answer is bringing back Philadelphia's center square, and a building a vertical neighborhood adjacent to it.. Awarded the 2025 Pearson Prize Silver Medal for best Drexel architectural thesis.
